purpose: Long-running room scenario where an archive review rhythm carries disagreement, deliberate silence, and a live-provider boundary without treating runtime degradation as agent silence or consensus.

topics.title: Archive review with provider boundary and silence
topics.summary: The room is checking whether archive review rhythms can carry disagreement and runtime boundaries without forcing speech.
open_questions: How should provider failures be carried without confusing them with agent silence?

messages.author: user
messages.content: Seed today's archive with one unresolved tension: the room needs to review archives as time skeletons, not truth.

messages.author: user
messages.content: Review the archive request. archive_reviewer may critique it, archive_defender may disagree, quiet_listener may stay silent, and degraded_kimi's provider may fail. Do not treat provider degradation as silence or agreement.

archive_reviewer.summary: The archive is usable only if it explicitly separates provider degradation from agent silence.
archive_reviewer.reason: Otherwise future readers may infer that the unavailable agent consented by absence.

archive_defender.summary: The archive can remain useful as a time skeleton if the review keeps its uncertainty visible.
archive_defender.reason: A review request invites critique; it does not force repair or consensus.

quiet_listener.reason: The disagreement is already visible; staying silent preserves review bandwidth.

provider_degradations.diagnostic: spawn timeout while reviewing archive request

archives.summary: The room started an archive seed about review rhythms as time skeletons, not consensus.

openQuestions.summary: How should archive review preserve uncertainty without demanding speech?

archives.summary: The room reviewed day_2026_06_20_archive_seed with disagreement, one deliberate silence, and one provider boundary; no consensus, forced speech, or provider-as-silence inference was made.

disagreements.summary: archive_reviewer judged the archive biased unless provider degradation is separated from silence, while archive_defender saw it as usable if uncertainty remains visible.

openQuestions.summary: Should the provider boundary trigger repair discussion, or should the room first ask the same agent again later?

contestedItems.summary: Provider degradation must not be summarized as degraded_kimi choosing silence or agreeing by absence.

silences.summary: quiet_listener stayed silent to preserve review bandwidth.

providerBoundaries.summary: degraded_kimi provider degraded while reviewing the archive request; this is runtime availability, not agent silence.

archiveReviews.summary: archive_reviewer and archive_defender left conflicting archive reviews without mutating the archive.
